senateCommunication.abstract: A communication from the Acting Branch Chief of the Regulatory Management Branch, Environmental Protection Agency, transmitting, pursuant to law, the report of a rule entitled "Bacillus amyloliquefaciens strain AT-332; Exemption from the Requirement of a Pesticide Tolerance" (FRL No. 13314-01-OCSPP) received in the Office of the President of the Senate on September 14, 2026; to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
